title: Seven Hammer Clangs Taught a Baby Fear, Yet Half of Textbooks Got Little Albert Wrong
description:
You think babies are born afraid of rats and fur! Yet seven hammer clangs wired that fear from scratch! This is the true story of the Little Albert Experiment. Here is what went wrong in a hospital nursery.
